newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Dec 11.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Singapore bunker levels were supported on Wednesday as cargo prices stayed firm on some local buying interest, traders said. A major said volumes were not as healthy as high offers have pushed shipowners to the sidelines. MDO and gas oil prices were steady despite falling cargo prices as sellers refuse to lower offers, traders said.
